title: London: Royal City Explorer
summary: Seven nights across the centuries — the Tower of London and Westminster one day, Borough Market and Canary Wharf's glass towers the next, with a countryside day trip in between.
highlights: The Tower of London and the Crown Jewels
A walk across Tower Bridge at golden hour
Borough Market on a Saturday morning
A West End show followed by a proper pub dinner

itinerary.title: Arrive & Westminster
itinerary.description: Settle in near Westminster, then a guided morning past Big Ben and through Westminster Abbey.

itinerary.title: The Tower & Tower Bridge
itinerary.description: The Tower of London and the Crown Jewels, then a walk across Tower Bridge as the sun drops.

itinerary.title: Borough Market & the Thames
itinerary.description: A Saturday-morning food crawl through Borough Market, then an afternoon river cruise down to Greenwich.

itinerary.title: Windsor Castle
itinerary.description: A day trip out to Windsor, the oldest occupied castle in the world, with time in the town before the drive back.

itinerary.title: The British Museum & the West End
itinerary.description: A guided morning through the British Museum's highlights, then a West End show followed by a proper pub dinner.

itinerary.title: Canary Wharf & Camden
itinerary.description: A free morning at Camden Market, then an evening view of the glass towers of Canary Wharf from the river.

itinerary.title: Depart London
itinerary.description: A final morning before your transfer to the airport.

included: Tower of London entry with a Beefeater-led tour
Windsor Castle day trip with a guide
A dedicated trip consultant, reachable throughout
